name: Granite Registry
description: :yen: Store private Docker images alongside the workloads that pull them, with scoped read-only and read-write keys

name: Gantry (Desktop)
description: Native macOS app (SwiftUI, no Electron) for managing and monitoring Docker hosts, local and over SSH: fleet dashboard, live logs and stats, exec terminal, file browser, and a bundled MCP server for AI agents

name: bosun
description: A keyboard-driven terminal UI for Docker with compose project grouping, live logs, stats, and shell access

name: layerx
description: Inspect container image layers in a TUI — browse filesystem diffs, view file contents inline, sort by size, extract individual files, and gate CI on efficiency thresholds

name: Docker Commander
description: A self-hosted Docker management and monitoring UI with multi-host support, Compose management, aggregated logs, alerts, RBAC, vulnerability scanning, and MCP integration

name: DockScope
description: Visualizes Docker containers in a 3D dependency graph with live metrics, logs, and an in-browser terminal

name: Laradock
description: Full PHP development environment based on Docker, running Nginx/Apache, PHP, MySQL, Redis and more as swappable Compose services
